A.name: A
A.definition: crossing delta when the inherited ON geometry is re-expressed in the OFF grammar (Stage-0 conversion)

B.name: B
B.definition: ON vs OFF search result from the SAME converted common start, same code, same counted budget, only enable_multi_arc toggled

historical_C.note: historical mixed package (different start + unequal budget); it is A + B + budget/start differences, never a 20H number

C.note: historical 21H numbers; never mixed into the 20H effect B and never added to effect A

separation_rule: A, B and C are three distinct quantities: C is the historical 21H mixed-package difference (A + B + budget/start differences); A is conversion cost only; B is search-ability only. Never add A and B into one "value of multi-arc" number and never attribute the conversion cost to the search gain.
